body.ruleText:
rule dac_win_0158 {
  meta:
    author = "Detection Engineer"
    description = "Nltest / domain trust discovery - Behavior: Nltest / domain trust discovery. Anchor is process+flag or event id+field after classic/XML coalesce. Not telemetry_validated. Sysmon 1 nltest /dclist /domain_trusts"
    severity = "Medium"
    rule_id = "DAC-WIN-0158"
    source_language = "spl"
    converted_by = "rulebridge"
    mitre_attack_technique = "T1018"
    mitre_attack_technique = "T1482"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    $e.metadata.log_type = "WINDOWS_SYSMON"
    ($e.target.process.file.full_path = /\\nltest\.exe$/ nocase or $e.target.process.command_line = /nltest/ nocase)
    ($e.target.process.command_line = /\/domain_trusts/ nocase or $e.target.process.command_line = /\/dclist/ nocase or $e.target.process.command_line = /\/dsgetdc/ nocase)

  condition:
    $e
}
